_comment: Language-agnostic readings of the rusage buffer: the counters the kernel wrote (offset to unsigned 64-bit decimal), the return code of proc_pid_rusage and the footprint bytes a reader must report. Offsets follow struct rusage_info_v4: ri_resident_size 64, ri_phys_footprint 72.

readings.name: a browser helper: the footprint is far below the resident set
a process with a footprint of zero bytes is a reading
a footprint above four gigabytes needs all 64 bits
a refused process (not ours, or gone) answers null whatever the buffer holds
a footprint beyond the safe integers answers null
